changeRequests.title: Event Registration - Include incoming graduates in Invitees list
changeRequests.description:
The Business Team now wants the invitation logic to consider the delegate’s next Mandal progression as well. Accordingly, delegates who are expected to graduate to the next Mandal should be invited to the corresponding next-level event.

For example:

1. Bal_3 delegates graduating to Kishore_K1 → invited to the Kishore_K1 event
2. Kishore_K1 delegates graduating to Kishore_K2 → invited to the Kishore_K2 event
3. Kishore_K2 delegates graduating to Yuvak → invited to the Yuvak event
changeRequests.actionItem: Review the detailed requirements, assess development and testing effort, obtain CR approval, and finalize implementation timeline.

changeRequests.description:
Kishanbhai shared the “myBKY – Grammar-Spelling Errors” feedback file with us, which includes the grammar/spelling correction changes.

While reviewing the file, we observed that there are some changes where entire sentences have been revised/replaced, beyond the regular grammar and spelling corrections.

The Figma designs have already been reviewed and approved
changeRequests.actionItem: Update the spelling / Grammer / Sentences as per the shared documents

changeRequests.title: Rooming splash screen update
changeRequests.description:
As per the approved Figma design, the Rooming splash screen displayed all room types configured for the respective event. However, upon proceeding to room selection, users could only view the room types they were eligible to select, which created confusion and an inconsistent user experience.

To address this, a validation has been introduced on the splash screen itself. The screen will now display only those room types for which the user is eligible, ensuring consistency between the splash screen and the room selection page and providing a clearer user experience.
changeRequests.actionItem: Apply the validation on Rooming Splash screen as well
